planned_arguments.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create one finished Korean public-event poster: a single flat opaque image, portrait width:height 2:3, with all artwork and printed text composed together. It is a neighborhood clothing-repair and household-object exchange gathering, welcoming and easy for a first-time visitor to understand.

Whole design: an editorial comic with THREE large landscape scene frames progressing down the page, and generous adjacent information space. Use a staggered alternating rhythm: first frame on the right with title/event/date/time/place to its left; second frame on the left with bring/activity information to its right; third frame on the right with free/invitation information to its left. Each frame is a broad, substantial horizontal drawing with real actions and clear object states, not a tiny icon. These three scene-and-information rows govern the entire page. Do not turn this into one central picture with a giant top headline and a small bottom footer. Keep comfortable outer margins and enough inter-row breathing room. The first panel may start beside the title so the title belongs to the narrative start.

Scene continuity: in the first frame two ordinary neighborhood adults calmly examine the visibly unravelled lower seam of a terracotta button-front shirt lying across a shared worktable. One hand holds up the loose edge so a small open seam and trailing thread are visible. In the second frame show that SAME terracotta shirt, same shape and pocket, now laid flat while one adult hand completes a neat short row of stitches along the formerly open lower seam; the repaired seam is visibly joined, with a needle/thread doing plausible sewing rather than a decorative loop. Simple scissors and a spool have a functional place on the table. In the third frame show a different action: one neighbor passes a sturdy green handled household pitcher to another neighbor, both people's hands naturally supporting the same pitcher at the moment of transfer. The repaired terracotta shirt can be folded quietly on the table, connecting the day. Show clear giving/receiving gestures. Calm modest faces and everyday proportions, with enough bodies/table context to read human participation. No exaggerated cartoon expressions.

Visual system: consistent controlled dark brown ink contours, opaque flat warm colors, a light warm cream ground, terracotta garment, muted green pitcher and small ochre accents. Deliberate frame borders, clean flat color joins and crisp line finish. No shiny 3D, clay letters, gradients, photographic mockup, pasted paper/tape, random decoration, speech bubbles, dialogue, numbered steps, or invented captions. Warm and accessible rather than childish.

Typography and information: the title is a medium-size expressive Korean ink-like display face with intact regular Hangul proportions; it can wrap into two natural word groups. It must not be inflated, torn or oversized. All other text uses clear regular Korean print lettering, dark ink on the light unpatterned adjacent spaces, with open counters and consistent word spacing. Date, time, venue and participation information must be easily readable when the poster is displayed at 720 pixels wide. Give these information groups real area, not tiny fine print. Preserve natural word boundaries when wrapping. All nine entries below are the ONLY printed copy, each printed exactly ONCE, without quotation marks or labels. Keep their exact Hangul, digits, word spaces and punctuation; line breaks may occur only at existing word boundaries. Do not repeat text inside scenes. No logos or watermarks.

Exact copy, in reading order with its placement:
Title at the first narrative row: "한 번 더 쓰는 하루"
Event identification immediately beside/below the title: "동네 수선·교환 모임"
First-row schedule group: "2026.11.14 토요일"
Next line in that schedule group: "13:00–17:00"
Venue in the same clearly separate schedule group: "연희 생활센터"
Second-row bring group beside the examination/sewing story: "고칠 물건 하나, 바꿀 물건 하나"
Second-row activity line: "작은 옷 수선 · 생활물건 교환"
Third-row free entry beside the transfer scene: "참가비 없음"
Third-row invitation, clearly readable and welcoming: "천천히 들러요"

Output one complete poster only; the three legitimate story frames are part of this one composition, never a multi-poster comparison sheet. Opaque background. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력
